title: Clinical immunogenicity in rAAV gene therapy: Insights and implications.
snippet: Recombinant adeno-associated viruses (rAAV) provide prolonged therapeutic protein expression in multiple target organs after single administration, delivering significant clinical benefits with a well-characterized safety profile, and can be further supported by active immune management strategies.
